title: On Measuring the field with a rope
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：measure　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 measure 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the keeper ① measured the field with a rope before dawn, and every traveller in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② measures the field with a rope in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ measure the field with a rope at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ measured the field with a rope before — a line in the calendar for January 1986 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Measuring the field with a rope before dawn, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ measure the boys by their writing in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Measure the boys by their writing at once and never mention it again.

By 1999 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the calendar, and a new traveller from the next tower ⑧ measures the boys by their writing before dawn every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stair, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ measured the field with a rope again when nobody else would.

⑩ To measure the field with a rope, my mother said in 2004, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the tower remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the tower forgets, somebody measures the field with a rope in public again and somebody must measure the field with a rope before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 测量（一般过去式 measured the field with a rope：1992 年守夜人头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 测量（一般现在 measures the field with a rope：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 测量（不定式 to measure the field with a rope：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 测量（过去完成时 had measured the field with a rope：1986 年一月的年历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 测量（动名词 measuring the field with a rope 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 衡量（measure the boys by their writing：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去衡量用写字来衡量孩子们）
G. v. 衡量（measure the boys by their writing：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 测量（后段两处：新来的过路人照例 measures the boys by their writing，而母亲又一次 measured the field with a rope）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 measure 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1992 the keeper measured the field with a rope before dawn, and nobody in the tower forgot it.
Even now the keeper measures the field with a rope in public whenever the tower asks.
Measuring the field with a rope before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever measure the boys by their writing in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next tower measures the boys by their writing before dawn every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother measured the field with a rope again, and the tower remembered that half.
